translations.english: On hearing her words Sita was surprised. With a gentle smile she said, to Anasuya who was endowed with ascetic power, 'I think you have already granted me the boons'.
translations.hindi: हे सुशील ओर चरित्रवान्‌ पुरुषसिंह ! यह कोई आश्चयं की बात नहीं कि, तुममें ऐसी सुजनता है । क्योंकि पानी बह कर तो तालाब या गढ़ ही में जमा होता है
